```{r}
#| label: tbl-agent-per-infection-rate
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$tbl_cap_engine else sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

# The version of the table the report renders: the reporting groups of the
# released classification, or the full ontology when the parameter asks for
# it. A dataset saved before the classification engine carries no ontology
# version.
# NEOIPC-PERMANENT(dataset-format): never drop this fallback. A stored
# dataset outlives every release, and this report renders a dataset saved
# before the engine arrived no matter how far compatibility moves on; see the
# marker of the same scope in `_setup.qmd`.
ia_slot <- if (identical(infectious_agent_rows, "ontology"))
  "infectious_agent_detection_rate_per_agent_ontology_table" else
  "infectious_agent_detection_rate_per_agent_table"
tbl_data <- reference_data[[ia_slot]]
if (is.null(tbl_data)) {
  ia_slot <- "infectious_agent_detection_rate_per_agent_table"
  tbl_data <- reference_data[[ia_slot]]
}

# Rows keyed by node_id come from the classification engine; rows keyed by
# their printed label come from the taxonomy that preceded it.
ia_engine <- "node_id" %in% names(tbl_data)
ia_groups <- identical(ia_slot, "infectious_agent_detection_rate_per_agent_table")

cw <- compute_col_widths(tbl_data, stub_min = 34)

# Reset to the default CI pattern in case an earlier sibling table mutated
# the shared `ci_pattern` to inline.
ci_pattern <- ci_pattern_default

# The infection-type columns beside the pooled share: every reference
# department's share among the confirmed infections of that type. The
# denominators themselves are not printed.
ia_type_headers <- c(
  bsi = sR$primary_sepsis_bsi_sc,
  hap = sR$pneumonia_sc,
  nec = sR$necrotizing_enterocolitis_sc,
  ssi = sR$ssi_sc)
ia_types <- if (ia_engine)
  ia_type_headers[paste0("pooled_", names(ia_type_headers)) %in%
                     names(tbl_data)] else
    character(0)

tbl <- tbl_data |>
  dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(".ontology_path")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = dplyr::if_else(
      !ia_engine & stringr::str_detect(group, "spp."),
      paste0("*", stringr::str_extract(group, "^(.+) spp\\.(.*)$", 1), "* spp.", stringr::str_extract(group, "^(.+) spp\\.(.*)$", 2)),
      group
      )) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    !!sR$table_headers$count := "n",
    !!sR$table_headers$pooled := "pooled",
    !!sR$table_headers$q1 := "q1",
    !!sR$table_headers$q2 := "q2",
    !!sR$table_headers$q3 := "q3")

if (length(ia_types) > 0) {
  ia_type_old_cols <- stats::setNames(
    paste0("pooled_", names(ia_types)), unname(ia_types))
  tbl <- tbl |> dplyr::rename(!!!ia_type_old_cols)
}

# Columns no cell shows: the engine's tree bookkeeping and the per-row
# denominators. `level` stays, hidden, for the stub indent.
if (ia_engine)
  tbl <- tbl |> dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(c(
    "node_id", "parent_id", "rank", "quartile_departments",
    "n_total_only", "total",
    paste0("n_", names(ia_types)),
    paste0("total_", names(ia_types)))))

# Row styling: the engine styles by `rank` and the row identity; the older
# table styled by `taxon`.
ia_node_id <- if (ia_engine) as.character(tbl_data$node_id) else character(0)
ia_summary <- if (ia_engine)
  !is.na(ia_node_id) & grepl("^[a-z_]+\\|", ia_node_id) else
  rep(FALSE, nrow(tbl_data))
ia_bold <- if (ia_engine) {
  (tbl_data$level == 0) |
    (ia_groups & !is.na(ia_node_id) & !ia_summary) |
    ia_summary |
    (!ia_groups & !is.na(tbl_data$rank) & tbl_data$rank %in%
       c("Domain", "Kingdom", "Realm", "Subkingdom", "Phylum",
         "Order", "Genus", "Group"))
} else {
  rep(FALSE, nrow(tbl_data))
}
ia_italic <- if (ia_engine) {
  !is.na(tbl_data$rank) & tbl_data$rank %in% c(
    "Realm", "Domain", "Subkingdom", "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Subphylum",
    "Class", "Subclass", "Order", "Suborder", "Family", "Subfamily",
    "Species", "Subspecies", "Serotype", "Variety")
} else {
  rep(FALSE, nrow(tbl_data))
}

gt_tbl <- tbl |>
  gt(rowname_col = "group") |>
  sub_missing() |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = c("group")) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    latex.header_repeat = TRUE,
    latex.use_longtable = TRUE,
    table.width = pct(100),
    table.font.size = cw$font_size,
    footnotes.marks = "extended"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = !(tidyselect::any_of(sR$table_headers$count) | tidyselect::matches("^(group|level|taxon)$")),
    decimals = 1,
    sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
    min_sep_threshold = 2,
    locale = locale_gt) |>
  fmt_integer(
    columns = sR$table_headers$count,
    sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
    min_sep_threshold = 2)

# Pooled rate CI merge
if (include_pooled_ci && "ci_lower" %in% colnames(gt_tbl$`_data`)) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    cols_merge(
      columns = c(sR$table_headers$pooled, "ci_lower", "ci_upper"),
      pattern = ci_pattern,
      rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled))
} else if ("ci_lower" %in% colnames(gt_tbl$`_data`)) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |> gt::cols_hide(columns = c("ci_lower", "ci_upper"))
}

# The infection-type shares, each with its own interval.
for (ia_type in names(ia_types)) {
  ia_type_col <- ia_types[[ia_type]]
  ia_type_ci <- paste0(c("ci_lower_", "ci_upper_"), ia_type)
  if (include_pooled_ci && all(ia_type_ci %in% colnames(gt_tbl$`_data`))) {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(ia_type_col, ia_type_ci[1], ia_type_ci[2]),
        pattern = ci_pattern_inline,
        rows = !is.na(tbl_data[[paste0("pooled_", ia_type)]])
      )
  } else if (all(ia_type_ci %in% colnames(gt_tbl$`_data`))) {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::cols_hide(columns = tidyselect::all_of(ia_type_ci))
  }
}

# Quartile bootstrap CI merge
if ("q1_ci_lower" %in% colnames(gt_tbl$`_data`)) {
  if (include_quartile_ci) {
    has_boot <- !is.na(gt_tbl$`_data`[["q1_ci_lower"]])
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(sR$table_headers$q1, "q1_ci_lower", "q1_ci_upper"),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = has_boot) |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(sR$table_headers$q2, "q2_ci_lower", "q2_ci_upper"),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = has_boot) |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(sR$table_headers$q3, "q3_ci_lower", "q3_ci_upper"),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = has_boot)
  } else {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |> gt::cols_hide(columns = tidyselect::any_of(c(
      "q1_ci_lower", "q1_ci_upper",
      "q2_ci_lower", "q2_ci_upper",
      "q3_ci_lower", "q3_ci_upper")))
  }
}

# The infection-type columns take fixed widths, the stub gives up the space.
ia_type_w <- if (length(ia_types) > 0) 8 else 0
ia_stub_w <- max(cw$stub - length(ia_types) * ia_type_w, 24)

gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
  cols_width(
    stub() ~ pct(ia_stub_w),
    sR$table_headers$count ~ pct(cw$n),
    sR$table_headers$pooled ~ pct(cw$pooled),
    sR$table_headers$q1 ~ pct(cw$q),
    sR$table_headers$q2 ~ pct(cw$q),
    sR$table_headers$q3 ~ pct(cw$q),
    tidyselect::any_of(unname(ia_types)) ~ pct(ia_type_w))

gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
  gt::tab_stub_indent(
    rows = gt::everything(),
    indent = gt::from_column(column = "level")
  )

if (ia_engine) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_stub(rows = ia_bold)
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(style = "italic"),
      locations = cells_stub(rows = ia_italic)
    )
} else {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(
        weight = "bold"
      ),
      locations = cells_stub(
        rows = taxon %in% c(
          "none",
          "domain",
          "kingdom",
          "order",
          "genus",
          "coag_type")
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(
        style = "italic"
        ),
      locations = cells_stub(
        rows = taxon %in% c(
          "domain",
          "kingdom",
          "order",
          "species")
        )
      )
}

gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
  cols_hide(columns = any_of(c("level","taxon"))) |>
  tab_spanner(
    label = sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$`rate_name`,
    columns = tidyselect::any_of(
     c(
     sR$table_headers$pooled,
     sR$table_headers$q1,
     sR$table_headers$q2,
     sR$table_headers$q3)),
    id = "infectious_agent_detection_rate"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = list(
      cells_column_spanners(),
      cells_column_labels(),
      cells_row_groups()
    )
  ) |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = md(
      paste0(
        "$$\\text{",
        sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_name,
        "} = \\frac{\\text{",
          if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_numerator_engine else
            sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_numerator,
        "}}{\\text{",
          if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_denominator_engine else
            sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$rate_denominator,
        "}} \\times ",
        format_integer(100),
        "$$"
      )),
    locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "infectious_agent_detection_rate"),
    placement = "right"
  ) |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = interpolate_translation(
      if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$n_footnote_engine
                     else sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$n_footnote,
      column = sR$table_headers$count),
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = sR$table_headers$count),
    placement = "right") |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = interpolate_translation(
      sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$pooled_footnote,
      column = sR$table_headers$pooled),
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = sR$table_headers$pooled),
    placement = "right")

if (length(ia_types) > 0) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    tab_spanner(
      label = sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$type_columns_label,
      columns = tidyselect::all_of(unname(ia_types)),
      id = "agent_type_shares",
      level = 2
    ) |>
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$type_share_footnote,
      locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "agent_type_shares"),
      placement = "right"
    )
}

# A share is flagged where its denominator is sparse; the Total, a count and
# not a share, is flagged on its own count. The denominators are not printed,
# so the footnote marks the share itself.
if (ia_engine) {
  ia_sparse <- !is.na(tbl_data$pooled) & tbl_data$level > 0 &
    tbl_data$total < sparse_threshold
  ia_sparse_total <- !is.na(tbl_data$pooled) & tbl_data$level == 0 &
    tbl_data$n < sparse_threshold
  fn_text <- if (include_pooled_ci) sR$sparse_data_footnote else sR$sparse_data_footnote_no_ci
  fn_text <- interpolate_translation(fn_text, threshold = sparse_threshold)
  if (any(ia_sparse, na.rm = TRUE))
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::tab_footnote(
        footnote = fn_text,
        locations = cells_body(
          columns = sR$table_headers$pooled,
          rows = ia_sparse),
        placement = "right")
  if (any(ia_sparse_total, na.rm = TRUE))
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::tab_footnote(
        footnote = fn_text,
        locations = cells_body(
          columns = sR$table_headers$count,
          rows = ia_sparse_total),
        placement = "right")

  # The Total's infectious agents that no row counts, from `n_total_only`.
  ia_total_only <- tbl_data$n_total_only[1]
  if (!is.null(ia_total_only) && !is.na(ia_total_only) && ia_total_only > 0) {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::tab_footnote(
        footnote = interpolate_translation(
          sR$`tbl-agent-per-infection-rate`$total_only_footnote,
          count = format_integer(ia_total_only)),
        locations = cells_body(
          columns = sR$table_headers$count,
          rows = tbl_data$level == 0),
        placement = "right")
  }
} else {
  # Sparse-data footnote for N < sparse_threshold
  if (any(!is.na(tbl_data$pooled) & tbl_data$n < sparse_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    fn_text <- if (include_pooled_ci) sR$sparse_data_footnote else sR$sparse_data_footnote_no_ci
    fn_text <- interpolate_translation(fn_text, threshold = sparse_threshold)
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::tab_footnote(
        footnote = fn_text,
        locations = cells_body(
          columns = sR$table_headers$count,
          rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled) & tbl_data$n < sparse_threshold),
        placement = "right")
  }
}

# n.o.s. definition source note: the engine marks a residual row by its
# identity, the older table by its taxon. The footnote beside `nos_footnote`
# explains residuals above the genus, where the genus footnote stops short.
ia_residual <- if (ia_engine)
  !is.na(ia_node_id) & grepl("~n\\.o\\.s\\.$", ia_node_id) else
  tbl_data$taxon == "species_nos"
if (any(ia_residual, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    gt::tab_source_note(source_note = sR$nos_footnote)
  if (ia_engine && any(ia_residual & !grepl("\\|genus/", ia_node_id),
                       na.rm = TRUE))
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      gt::tab_source_note(
        source_note = sR$residual_above_genus_footnote)
}
# The groups version alone carries the summary block beside its tree.
if (ia_engine && ia_groups && any(ia_summary, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    gt::tab_source_note(
      source_note = sR$summary_block_note)
}

gt_tbl
```
